content.comment_body: Is it possible to update the firmware from 1.81.04 to 1.82.01 on a PLC with article number [article_no]? Other units with [article_no] have firmware 1.82.02.
Firmware updates from version 1.81.x to 1.82.x are not possible. Upgrades are limited to incremental changes within the same minor version, such as from 1.81.x to 1.81.y, or from 1.82.x to 1.82.y.

analysis.insight_summary: The user tried updating firmware from 1.81.04 to 1.82.01 on a PLC with article number [article_no], but faced hardware compatibility issues. Responses clarified version-specific limitations, particularly tied to hardware series, which affected efforts to keep devices consistent. Feedback underscores confusion in documentation regarding hardware and firmware compatibility and available upgrade paths.
